screens.caption: Sleep is a rumor. I heard it once, back in 2019.
She's got no teeth and she runs my whole economy.
I sell my blood twice a week. It buys me back a Tuesday.
Two trips is for people with nothing to prove.
Earl doesn't drink coffee. Earl outlasts it.
Nobody saw anything. Everybody saw everything.
Nebraska has two seasons: the fight and the thaw.
Brittany has twenty bucks on the goose.
Sunday brunch. Two hundred people want eggs the way their mother never made them.
The raccoon and I split family meal. He has better benefits.
I offer the landlord a jar of quarters and my whole heart. He takes the quarters.
The cats bring {baby} an offering. She accepts it. I sleep with one eye open now.
{partner}'s ex spots me on bench. Neither of us says a word. That's the whole friendship.
Me versus a waffle the size of a car. The waffle has the reach. I have the syrup.
